study type: secondary data analysis on cross-sectional data
cohort: Infants under 6 months of age in the Dominican Republic
finding: C-sections remained significantly related to the child not put to the breast within 1 h after delivery, milk-based prelacteal feeds, and current non-breast milk use, even after controlling for sociodemographic variables.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly related to not putting the child to breast within 1 h after delivery, milk-based prelacteal feeds, and current non-breast milk use.
